about: 20 tasks for T3.5. 16 need the library's MCP tools (servers context7, exa, hf, shopify, replayed by stub-server.mjs from tools/*.json); 4 are controls that need only built-in tools. Every entity is made up, so no answer comes from the model's memory. A task passes when every token in `tokens` appears in the final answer (case-insensitive) or, for `checkFile`, in that file; the token is only in the stub's reply to the right call with the right arguments (or in the work folder for controls).
